caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped object with a green outer frame. The frame has a rounded rectangular cross-section, with a prominent hinge or connecting bar at the top and a decorative knop or finial at the bottom. Inside the green frame, there is a gray-toned, detailed floral design consisting of a central oval element surrounded by radiating petals, giving a sunburst or flower-like appearance. The drawing uses shading to create a sense of depth and dimension, especially on the floral element and the green frame. The object is centered on a cream-colored background, enclosed within faintly drawn rectangular guidelines. At the bottom left, the word "SCALE" is written with a small scale reference, and in the bottom right corner, the name "E.L. Pearce" is inscribed.
title: Door Knocker
